success.description: 3 power, must be outdoors or within close range of leafy plants. Effect: A flurry of autumn leaves surrounds you, hiding you from view. When you attempt a Stealth (Ag) check or other check where concealment would be relevant, spend 3 power and place 4 recharge tokens on this card to add {Dc} to the dice pool.

reckless.requirements: 3 power, must be outdoors or within close range of leafy plants. Effect: A flurry of leaves surrounds you or your ally, hiding you from view. When you or an ally within close range of you are targeted by a Ranged Attack or an Observation (Int) check or other skill to detect you, you may spend 3 power and place 4 recharge tokens on this card to add {Dm} to the dice pool.
